name: Bone Counter Right
purpose: Misdirection off the pitch. The near halfback and the quarterback sell the pitch one way and the far halfback plants and comes all the way back. Nobody pulls: our end drives their end out, the guard climbs to the middle linebacker and the fullback leads up through the hole onto the playside linebacker, so the ball hits fast behind a lead blocker.

LE.rule: Cut off pursuit from behind. You are the last one to the ball, so never quit on the play.

LT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you — nobody crosses your face.

LG.rule: Nobody is over you. Cut off the backside.

C.rule: You have the nose, head up on you. Hands inside and do not let him cross your face to the playside.

RG.rule: Nobody is over you. Climb straight to the middle linebacker and take him wherever he goes.

RT.rule: The tackle is on your inside shoulder. Block him down and seal him inside — that is what opens the hole.

RE.rule: Block the end over you and drive him out, away from the hole. Nobody is kicking him out for you — he is yours.

QB.rule: Fake the pitch to the left, then turn back and hand the ball to the other halfback coming across. The fake comes first.

FB.rule: Step at the dive to hold them, then go up through the hole and block the playside linebacker. You are the lead blocker — the ball is right behind you.

LH.rule: Take two hard steps toward the fake, then plant and come all the way back behind the pulling guard.

RH.rule: Run the full pitch path away at full speed with your arms tucked. You are the lie.

coaching_points: Do not call this until the pitch has been working. It is the counter-punch.
No pullers, so this hits faster than Power. The line has to hold its blocks while the ball carrier crosses, but nobody is waiting on a guard to get there.
The fullback's block on the playside linebacker is what springs it. Drill that block on its own.
Two hard steps toward the fake before he comes back. A shuffle fools nobody.
